name: ogbn-products
description: A product co-purchasing network derived from Amazon product data. Nodes represent products, edges indicate that two products are frequently bought together, and node features and labels support product-category prediction.
citation: Hu, W., Fey, M., Zitnik, M., Dong, Y., Ren, H., Liu, B., Catasta, M., & Leskovec, J. (2020). Open Graph Benchmark: Datasets for Machine Learning on Graphs. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 33. https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.00687
